The main takeaway from our work is that
fibroblasts from patients with Parkinson’s disease (PD) can be reprogrammed to dopaminergic (DA) neurons that recapitulate some of the functional and molecular properties of PD DA neurons.
fibroblasts from patients with PD can be used to generate functional dopaminergic neurons in vitro.
the use of human iPSCs and CRISPR/Cas9 technology is a powerful tool for the study of Parkinson's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
